title.en: The riff that ate the band
title.zh: 把乐队吃掉的那句 riff

summary.en: One hook pays the mortgage and freezes the setlist. Income stream and trap.
summary.zh: 一个 hook 付房贷，也锁死歌单。饭票和笼子一起到。

body.en:
Satisfaction. Smoke on the Water. Teen Spirit. The crowd waits for that shape; everything else becomes "the other songs."

Bands cope differently: lean into greatest-hits mode, joke about it onstage, or do the Radiohead move—mutate until the hit feels like a previous life. Once a riff is that big, culture owns it more than the band does.
body.zh:
Satisfaction。Smoke on the Water。Teen Spirit。观众等的是那个形状；其它歌都成「剩下的」。

乐队活法不同：迎上去做精选辑模式、台上自嘲，或者学 Radiohead——改到那首热歌听起来像上辈子。Riff 大到那个份上，文化比乐队更拥有它。

note.en: Smoke on the Water: guitar-shop national anthem.
note.zh: Smoke on the Water：琴行国歌。

note.en: Teen Spirit still owns the public image.
note.zh: Teen Spirit 仍压着公共形象。

note.en: Deliberately left the early hit behind.
note.zh: 刻意把早期热歌甩在身后。
